description: A pure CALCULATION node — merge several graphs into one: graphs in, one graph out. Draws nothing on canvas.
instructions:
A value-only node: it takes SEVERAL GRAPHS and returns their union as one graph JSON. It has no geometry input or output and draws nothing on the canvas.

INPUT: wire more than one val-graph into the single valin-graph handle (fan-in) — every source's graph is merged. Nodes at the same position (in the shared anchor frame) collapse to one, so graphs that meet at a junction stay connected; overlapping edges are de-duplicated. Each edge keeps ITS OWN `thickness`, so a 0.2 m outer-wall graph and a 0.1 m inner-wall graph merge into one graph with both thicknesses preserved.

OUTPUT: val-graph publishes the merged graph — wire it into a Network node to draw it, or into another graph node to process it further.
